title: State Management Store Generator
description: Generate Zustand stores or React Context providers for state management with TypeScript type safety and custom hooks.

name.description: Name of the store (e.g., userStore, productStore, authStore). Uses camelCase naming conventions.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this store?

package.description: Subdirectory within src/ where stores are created (default: 'stores' creates src/stores/)

directory.description: Override the entire directory path for store creation

projectName.description: Target project name where store will be generated. Auto-creates feature if not found.

useContext.description: Generate as React Context provider instead of Zustand (default: false creates Zustand store)

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)

export.description: Export the generated store from project root src/index.ts (default: true)
